svg.aria-label: The margins by which the label clears the lower edge, for u from 0 to 31/40, and the upper edge, for u up to 1/2, at the closest admissible state with the given u. Both stay positive; the lower one comes down to about 0.0047 near u = 0.72, the upper one to arcsin 3/5 - 5/8 at u = 1/10
